ev.q: 52 cases of trichinellosis were identified by the public health surveillance systems in 11 cities and districts of the state of Northrhine-Westfalia (NRW), Germany
Case-patients and controls were interviewed by telephone using a standardized questionnaire.

changes.why: The surveillance systems are German, so they are international surveillance rather than U.S. state or local surveillance.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension appears; exposures are foods and place of purchase, and controls are matched only by town.
